bagPolicy.summary: Small handbags and bags up to 35 × 40 × 19 cm may enter; large bags are prohibited and there is no stadium bag storage.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking at the stadium is extremely limited and, where available, reserved for blue badge holders. For third-party events, blue badge parking is first come, first served and booked through the stadium, with details given when you buy tickets. Cardiff Council provides general travel and parking information.

rideshare.summary: A taxi rank is on St Mary Street, outside the House of Fraser building.

concessions.summary: The stadium has bars and food outlets; guests must finish any outside food and drink before entering.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stadium uses a Nimbus Access Card process; Blue Badge parking requests are arranged through the event’s ticketing channel.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The published stadium ground rules prohibit readmission after leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The stadium’s general entry and safety pages do not give a universal Will Call or collection process for concerts.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Use the gate printed on the ticket and be prepared for a bag search before scanning at the turnstile. Ground rules warn that arrival fewer than 30 minutes before an event may delay admission.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
